aboutSection.title: ABOUT
paragraphs: AlienX was born from the passion for storytelling through digital media. We are an independent studio dedicated to creating gaming experiences that transcend common entertainment.
Each project is developed with meticulous attention to detail, combining deep narrative, innovative mechanics, and art that transports players to extraordinary worlds.
We believe games have the power to move, teach, and connect people in unique ways. Our mission is to create titles that leave a lasting mark on the memory of those who play.

hero.title: CREATING IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCES
hero.subtitle: A studio founded by gamers, for gamers.

history.originText: AlienX is a development studio founded by game development graduates, players, and artists. We believe in cross-platform play: we want everyone to play together, regardless of their chosen platform.
history.trajectoryText: Based in Rio de Janeiro and founded on December 28, 2016, our mission is clear: to provide the best possible experience in immersive games, creating charismatic characters and engaging gameplay.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: AlienX Game Studio values user privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use our services.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We may collect personal information such as name, email address, app usage data, and device technical information when you interact with our games and services.

dataUsage.title: Use of Information
dataUsage.content: We use your information to improve our games, provide customer support, send important updates, and personalize your gaming experience.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share aggregated and anonymized data for analytical purposes or as required by law.

dataSecurity.title: Information Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or limit the processing of your personal information. Contact us to exercise these rights.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.content: For questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: privacy@alienx.com or visit our contact page.
